sources.title: Lebanese Ministry of Culture: Support for cinematographic works (English and Arabic pages)
sources.said: The Ministry of Culture contributes to the financing of the productions and activities of the cultural industries and the knowledge economy especially the production of films, documentaries and audio-visual publications. A special committee is in charge of reviewing and assessing the films. … Eligible projects: feature length film, feature length documentary, short film, short documentary, experimental film and animated film. Eligible fields: script development for long and short films, research for documentary films, technical operations of filming, editing and mixing, etc., promotion of the film and participation in Special festivals

sources.title: Lebanese Ministry of Culture: Support Requests
sources.said: Support requests are accepted starting from January to mid-September in the following cultural areas: → Support for Cinematographic Works → Support for Theatrical Works → Support for Associations, Cultural Clubs, and Creators → Book Purchase Request → Painting Purchase Request

sources.title: Lebanese Ministry of Culture: Support for Theatrical Works (English and Arabic pages)
sources.said: A special committee is in charge of reviewing the file of the theatrical work. Thus, the ministry decides to grant its support to the theatrical work to which the committee gave its approval. … Only the producer of the play, whether a natural person or an institution, is entitled to submit the application. … The approval is deemed final once signed by the Minister of Culture. The support decision is effective for a period of two years (with the possibility of 6 month extension) during which the theatrical work must be completed. The producer shall repay the entire amount of the financial support if the project is not completed. … The approval of the censorship department of the Lebanese General Security. … The Certificate of registration at the Ministry of Finance.

figures.finding: Not reached today. Scope of the absence: the Ministry of Culture's only audiovisual support, read whole in English and Arabic, names no series or television work. New for the producer file (whose blocker says no film fund was found): the Ministry does fund film production by committee, no amounts published. AFAC (arabculturefund.org) is a private regional fund, not public; its Cinema programme and the AFAC-Netflix Hardship Fund for the film and TV community exist (programs page read).

The application is filed on paper at the Ministry in Beirut; no base rule beyond Lebanese registration with the Ministry of Finance is stated. AFAC's private Performing Arts grant (max USD 50,000, Arab nationals or residents, one call a year) is an alternative a Lebanese company may seek; it is not public money.
